params.body:
Closes #278

The manuals page (`documentation.show`) shows each manual in an iframe. `frame-src` only allowed `docs.google.com` and `drive.google.com`, so the renewed teacher manual, made as a Genially, would show "Deze content is geblokkeerd".

- `frame-src` gains `https://view.genially.com`, the host Genially serves public views from. Only that host, no wildcard, same as the Google ones.
- `SecureHeadersMiddlewareTest` asserts the new policy; `NoThirdPartyRequestsTest` lists Genially with the manual embeds, which only load when someone opens the manual.

Checked: the Genially view sends no `X-Frame-Options` and no `frame-ancestors`, so it can be embedded. The same manual's PDF on Google Drive is not shared publicly and redirects to a Google sign-in page that refuses framing, so the Genially is the link to add.

After merge, an admin adds it with "Handleiding toevoegen": name and the Genially URL.

Tests: the two affected test classes pass (10 tests). The full suite on the workbench has 21 failures, the same ones a plain `origin/main` shows there (Chrome printing, Vite manifest, BuildStamp, report PDFs); none touch the CSP.
params.title: Allow the Genially teacher manual in frame-src
